subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Does the repository accept the proposed breaking reshapes for the documented v2026.7.2-beta protocol families before npm publication?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes public-facing gateway contracts and removes exports; the asserted absence of shipped consumers is a release-policy decision that code review alone cannot safely make.

options.title: Accept the beta compatibility window
options.body: Confirm that the named question, worker, and session-catalog contract changes may break beta consumers, then require real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility path
options.body: Keep the existing shapes or add a documented migration/deprecation path if external beta consumers must continue working.

options.title: Split the release policy work
options.body: Land only non-breaking cleanup and vintage tracking, while moving contract reshapes to a separately approved compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Accept the beta compatibility window
recommendation.body: Confirm that the named question, worker, and session-catalog contract changes may break beta consumers, then require real runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows this contributor authored the protocol audit, consumer migrations, and CI guard that define the decision surface.
